# phx_new v1.8.8 - Table of Contents

> Phoenix framework project generator.

Provides a `mix phx.new` task to bootstrap a new Elixir application
with Phoenix dependencies.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix local.phx](https://phx-new.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Local.Phx.md): Updates the Phoenix project generator locally.
- [mix phx.new](https://phx-new.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phx.New.md): Creates a new Phoenix project.
- [mix phx.new.ecto](https://phx-new.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phx.New.Ecto.md): Creates a new Ecto project within an umbrella project.
- [mix phx.new.web](https://phx-new.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Phx.New.Web.md): Creates a new Phoenix web project within an umbrella project.
